scientific_integrity: Complete mathematical proof given; separate exhaustive and paired-class verification code and output supplied. Prior general theorems are credited; finite checks are not represented as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the binary synchronous open-neighbor majority rule with tie retention on connected crown graphs with n >= 3. Older 1980 and 1988 sources have verified publication years but no verified first-public day in the inspected material. Unindexed prior equivalent work may exist; no independent scientific audit has occurred.
title: Parity bifurcation of majority clocks on crown graphs
